Gorge and Juno Gold Projects - Q&A Interview with Tom Harris Now Available

GEO Exploration Limited (AIM: GEO) is pleased to announce that Tom Harris, the Company's Australian Exploration Manager, has recorded an interview discussing the Company's gold exploration portfolio and the latest geological developments across Gorge and Juno.

The interview is intended to provide investors who are new to GEO with an introduction to the Company's gold portfolio, while also providing existing shareholders with further insight into the latest exploration progress, geological interpretation and upcoming work across Gorge and Juno.
The interview can be viewed on YouTube at the following link:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kFATtNDz2gc
The interview is also available through the Company's social media platforms.
The interview covers:
·      What attracted GEO's technical team to the Gorge and Juno gold projects.
·      Why Gorge is emerging as a key focus within GEO's gold portfolio.
·      What the latest geochemical results are revealing about the scale and potential of the Gorge system.
·      The significance of gold being identified across 99.6% of samples at Gorge.
·      What GEO has learned from its maiden diamond drilling programme at Juno.
·      How those learnings are shaping the next phase of exploration at Juno.
·      The key catalysts and exploration milestones ahead across the gold portfolio.
·      The potential significance of future drilling at Gorge.
